---
output: pdf_document
---

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(dplyr)
library(broom)
library(tinytex)
library(gtsummary)
library(kableExtra)

clean_data <- read.csv("data/clean_state_data.csv")
```

```{r}
clean_data_table1 <- clean_data %>%
  rename("% Insured" = pct_insuredE,
         "% with Bachelor's Degree or higher" = pct_bachelors_plusE,
         "% Living Under Poverty Line" = pct_povertyE,
         "% Living in Urban Area" = pct_urban,
         "Public Health Funding per Capita" = phf_per_capita) %>%
  mutate(exposure = case_when(
    exposure_binary == 0 ~ "Non-Permissive Exemptions",
    TRUE ~ "Permissive Exemptions"
  ))

clean_data_table1 %>%
  tbl_summary(include = c(`% Insured`, `% with Bachelor's Degree or higher`, `% Living Under Poverty Line`, `% Living in Urban Area`, `Public Health Funding per Capita`),
         by = exposure, type = all_dichotomous() ~ "categorical", missing_text = "NA") %>%
  bold_labels() %>%
  modify_caption("Demographic Characteristics of 50 US States, 2024") %>%
  as_kable_extra(booktabs = TRUE, longtable = TRUE, linesep = "") %>%
  kableExtra::kable_styling(position = "center", latex_options = "hold_position", font_size = 9) %>%
  column_spec(2:4, width = "3.5cm")
```
